description: This file defines the 'TemplateDate' class, which extends 'TemplateRange' and provides functionality for date field templates in the SuiteCRM application, including date string options, display logic, and default value handling.

classes.name: TemplateDate
classes.description: A class representing a date field template in SuiteCRM, providing date-specific default values, UI display, and field definition logic.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the TemplateDate object, setting up default date strings based on language strings.

methods.name: get_db_default
methods.description: Returns an empty string as the database default value for the date field.

methods.name: get_xtpl_edit
methods.description: Prepares template variables for editing the date field in the UI, including default value handling and help messages.

methods.name: get_field_def
methods.description: Returns the field definition array, adjusting default display settings if a default value exists.
